# Genesis Apocryphon Column 18 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 18 | **Condition:** Nearly destroyed

---

**18:1** [...] Abram [...] went out [...] from Ur of the Chaldeans [...]

**18:2** [...] and he came to Haran [...] and he dwelt there [...]

**18:3** [...] Terah his father [...] and Lot the son of Haran [...]

**18:4** [...] and Sarai his wife [...] and all their possessions [...]

**18:5** [...] and God said to Abram [...] Go out from your land [...]

**18:6** [...] and from your kindred [...] to the land which I shall show you [...]

**18:7** [...] and I shall make of you a great nation [...] and I shall bless you [...]

**18:8** [...] and Abram went out [...] as the LORD had spoken to him [...]

**18:9** [...] to the land of Canaan [...] and he crossed over [...]

**18:10** [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: SOPHIA follows LOGOS for the formal register of this pivotal narrative. "Go out from your land" (18:5) preserves the biblical lekh lekha tradition better than PNEUMA's "Leave your homeland." PNEUMA's "set out" (18:8) is too casual for a divinely commanded departure.*
